verdict.rationale: Gumroad documents recurring and fixed-length payments, memberships including SaaS subscriptions, and a public REST API covering subscribers, so the core recurring-billing capability exists. Nothing in the evidence covers trials, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration. missing for 10: free trial support, upgrade/downgrade between plans, proration logic, developer docs for configuring subscription plans via API, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Choose between one-time, recurring, or fixed-length payments in your currency of choice.
Whether it's for a podcast, online course, or SaaS subscriptions, Gumroad makes it easy to manage memberships.
public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
